description:
Saves a passage the reader asks to keep to their ReadingRate quotes, under a book in their library, with optional page, speaker, notes and themes. Saved quotes also appear in the ReadingRate app and in quote review.

Use when the user asks to save, keep or remember a quote or passage from a book. For a line of a poem, use save_poem_line.

Each call adds a new quote, so calling twice saves it twice.

Example: {"book_id": "<book id>", "quote_text": "124 was spiteful.", "page_number": 1}

book_id.description: The book the quote is from: its ReadingRate book id or library entry id

notes.description: The reader's note on the quote (max 2000 characters)

speaker.description: The character who says it, for dialogue (max 200 characters)

themes.description: Themes the quote touches (max 10, each max 100 characters)

name: save_quote

book.description: Book the quote belongs to: id, slug, title, authors

quote.description: The saved quote: id, text, page, speaker, notes, themes

settings_url.description: Settings link, returned when the reader has turned off saving quotes from assistants

total_quotes_for_book.description: Total quotes saved for this book

title: Save a quote
